name: @loom/blueprint-status
description: A plain loom app on Blueprint IR 2, no loom-ui: a service health board whose widgets bind a value AND a status channel in the app's own projection, whose spans ride in grid cells, and whose degraded widget says what it stands for — rendered headlessly through loom's terminal renderer with the app's value contract in the `check` seam. Proves loom alone gains the status channel.
